purpose: Teach: 打ち切り/有価/作り上げる/使い捨て/版元/レスポンス/率先/囲む

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、長期捜査の打ち切りも検討されますね
lines.en: The police are also considering discontinuing the long-term investigation.
lines.style: Respectful, observational tone. Measured pace. Acknowledging the institutional constraint with quiet understanding, not judgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、有価証券詐欺事件にも対応されてますね
lines.en: The police handle securities fraud cases too, I see.
lines.style: Interested, conversational. Light, curious inflection. The rhythm of someone noting a detail that expands their understanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯人像を捜査本部で作り上げるんですね
lines.en: So the investigative task force builds a suspect profile from the ground up.
lines.style: Steady, explanatory. A slight nod of recognition in the voice. Warm respect for the methodical process being described.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、使い捨ての手袋を犯行に用いた例も把握されてますね
lines.en: And they've catalogued cases where disposable gloves were used as evidence.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, engaged. The tone of someone following a logical thread. No inflation—just noting the detail as significant.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、出版物の版元との連携もされてますね
lines.en: The police also coordinate with publishers and the industry.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. Brief pause before the sentence lands. Recognition of an unexpected connection being made visible.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民通報のレスポンスを早めておられますね
lines.en: They're speeding up their response time to citizen tips.
lines.style: Approving, measured. Slight emphasis on 'speeding up'—noticing the effort. Warm but not effusive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民が率先して防犯活動に協力されますね
lines.en: Citizens are increasingly taking the initiative to support crime prevention efforts.
lines.style: Observational, slightly hopeful. Acknowledging the shift in civic participation with quiet warmth. Not lecturing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯行現場をテープで囲む手順を徹底されますね
lines.en: They're rigorous about the procedure—cordoning off the scene with tape.
lines.style: Firmer tone, closer. Direct admiration for the discipline. A touch of emphasis on 'rigorous.' The respect of someone who understands why precision matters.
